# ivanti-neurons-cli

> Command-line client for Ivanti Neurons for MDM (formerly MobileIron Cloud):
> search and inspect devices, run device actions (lock, wipe, retire,
> check-in, kiosk, lost mode), manage users, user and device groups, apps,
> configurations, certificates, bulk enrollment and tenant settings.
> Single static Go binary, configured via ~/.config/ivanti-neurons/config.yml
> or IVANTI_URL + IVANTI_USERNAME/IVANTI_PASSWORD (or IVANTI_CLIENT_ID/
> IVANTI_CLIENT_SECRET) environment variables.

The CLI is self-documenting for LLMs: run `ivanti-neurons docs` for the
complete command reference in one page. Every read command supports `-o json`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/lukeisontheroad/ivanti-neurons-cli/blob/main/README.md): install, auth, usage
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/lukeisontheroad/ivanti-neurons-cli/blob/main/skills/ivanti-neurons/SKILL.md): drop-in skill for AI agents operating the CLI
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/lukeisontheroad/ivanti-neurons-cli/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): commit convention, release automation
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/lukeisontheroad/ivanti-neurons-cli/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): architecture and API facts for coding agents

## Optional

- [Ivanti Neurons for MDM API guide](https://help.ivanti.com/mi/help/en_us/CLD/8x/api/default.htm): upstream REST API reference
